scope_note: Mission requirements describe intended capabilities, not achieved EDI capability. Only Observe is designed in this increment.

missions.statement: Develop a system that can observe unfamiliar inputs with or without an external goal, develop its own representations and relationships, investigate uncertainty, and retain revisable evidence-based knowledge that improves future prediction, interpretation and decisions.
missions.rationale: Consolidates the owner's stated EDI mission; no claim of realization.

stakeholder_sources.quote: Observation layer should allow continuously any type of information passing through it.
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Continuous heterogeneous acquisition within declared digital interfaces and capacity.

stakeholder_sources.quote: after two years it gets some information from the same element
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Persistent operational identity and evidence-backed recurrence across sessions and modalities.

stakeholder_sources.quote: observations fed without human priors into the next layer
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: No mandatory human domain ontology or semantic model output as the authoritative evidence; structural acquisition assumptions declared.

stakeholder_sources.quote: Apply Five Whys analysis, Waterfall analysis, MECE hypothesis
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Use explicit rationale, requirements cascade, scoped coverage partitions and falsifiable alternatives.

stakeholder_sources.quote: efficient, speed, and will consume less tokens and can operate at high availability and can be scaled for any level of data
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Measurable capacity/latency/token/availability targets, zero required intake inference, scalable profiles rather than infinite capacity.

stakeholder_sources.quote: mapping out requirements, functions, capabilities, and having a downstream link from top down
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Bidirectional trace with component allocation, acceptance and evidence status; reuse for later layers.

stakeholder_sources.quote: persistent revisable knowledge; multi-layer relationships; observation-only and goal-directed use
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Intended EDI system capabilities; future layers remain unimplemented by this work.

stakeholder_sources.quote: Design inference, not an additional owner instruction.
stakeholder_sources.interpretation: Durability, versioning, safety of parsing, capacity admission and operational observability are derived implementation obligations.

system_requirements.title: Operating modes
system_requirements.statement: The system shall support continuing observation both before an external task and while pursuing a supplied goal.
system_requirements.acceptance: Observation continues across a goal change without replacing acquired history.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Heterogeneous information
system_requirements.statement: The system shall accept source-native digitally supplied information through extensible interfaces while distinguishing capture, decoding and understanding.
system_requirements.acceptance: A mixed replay preserves supported native structures and explicitly records opaque or unsupported content.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Semantic neutrality
system_requirements.statement: The system shall distinguish host/acquisition assumptions and imported knowledge from representations or relationships learned from its own observations.
system_requirements.acceptance: Runtime evidence identifies supplied metadata, transformations and imported models; no required object ontology gates capture.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Endogenous representations
system_requirements.statement: The system shall develop and revise representations from allowed observations under declared learning assumptions.
system_requirements.acceptance: A future representation qualification shows experience-dependent structure with controls for supplied structure.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Relationship discovery
system_requirements.statement: The system shall form competing testable relationships without promoting unsupported patterns to established laws.
system_requirements.acceptance: A future discovery evaluation measures prospective discrimination and false discoveries.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Uncertainty
system_requirements.statement: The system shall preserve unknowns and distinguish acquired evidence, reports, interpretations and uncertainty about each.
system_requirements.acceptance: Observation fixtures retain missing/unknown/report/derived distinctions; later inference calibration remains separate.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Investigation
system_requirements.statement: The system shall be able to investigate uncertainty by requesting informative observations or permitted interventions.
system_requirements.acceptance: Observe records supported acquisition request outcomes; the future inquiry policy demonstrates informative selection.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Revision
system_requirements.statement: The system shall revise unsupported beliefs and operational associations when new evidence contradicts them without rewriting acquired evidence.
system_requirements.acceptance: Association correction preserves as-known history; future belief revision is separately evaluated.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Persistent experience
system_requirements.statement: The system shall retain addressable evidence and identity history across sessions and declared retention periods.
system_requirements.acceptance: Export/restore and simulated long-gap/replacement fixtures preserve qualified references and known losses.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Prediction and what-if
system_requirements.statement: The system shall use supported knowledge for prospective prediction and explicitly scoped counterfactual analysis.
system_requirements.acceptance: Future prediction evaluation reports held-out error, uncertainty and intervention assumptions.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Transfer
system_requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate whether prior learned structure improves unfamiliar related tasks against strong reset, conventional-memory and unrelated-history controls.
system_requirements.acceptance: Prospective matched transfer results establish scope; no advantage inferred from architecture alone.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Interpretation and proactive findings
system_requirements.statement: The system shall communicate interpretations and strategically useful new findings with evidence and uncertainty, including when no explicit question requested a finding.
system_requirements.acceptance: Future interpretation evaluation checks factual support, usefulness and appropriate abstention.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Resource efficiency
system_requirements.statement: The system shall operate within declared compute, memory, storage, latency and inference budgets and account for complete task costs.
system_requirements.acceptance: Pinned workloads report total accepted/failed work, latency, bytes, inference and resource bounds.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Audit and reproducibility
system_requirements.statement: The system shall preserve provenance, versions, decisions and evidence sufficient to reconstruct supported claims.
system_requirements.acceptance: Independent reconstruction follows recorded versions and receipts without post-hoc replacement of failures.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Reliable scalable operation
system_requirements.statement: The system shall provide explicit capacity, durability, recovery and availability guarantees for qualified deployment profiles.
system_requirements.acceptance: Each profile has workload/fault model, metrics and passing evidence; no unconditional or infinite-scale claim.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

system_requirements.title: Permitted actions and introspection
system_requirements.statement: The system shall distinguish proposed commands, authorized execution, reported acknowledgement, measured outcome and its own operational telemetry.
system_requirements.acceptance: Observation retains these distinctions; future goal/action authority and self-diagnosis remain separate.
system_requirements.rationale: Required to realize the stated mission under the referenced owner instruction or explicit engineering derivation.

observation_requirements.title: Continuous extensible intake
observation_requirements.statement: The observation layer shall receive configured live, historical, file and composite inputs without requiring a question or a known semantic class.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Mixed replay continues through goal changes and unknown media types; counts reconcile.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Native fidelity
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve received bytes and exact typed values, including precision, missingness and native structure within declared retention.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Digest/byte comparison and native-value comparisons match all acquired complete and partial payloads.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Source continuity
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall maintain scoped persistent deliverer/producer/channel identities, aliases and acquisition epochs without conflating producer with subject.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Restarts, alias changes, recycled names and moved sensors resolve using dated evidence or explicit unknowns.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Subject association
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall expose evidence-backed subject associations across time/modalities, allowing multiple subjects and unresolved identity.
observation_requirements.acceptance: All supported deterministic bindings match fixture truth; intentionally indistinguishable subjects remain unresolved.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Reversible identity history
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall retain valid-time and recorded-time association assertions and reversible correction/retraction history.
observation_requirements.acceptance: A mistaken association is retracted without changing raw records; historical and current queries return their declared versions.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Time and order
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve source times, clocks, epochs and ordering limits separately from receipt and commit times.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Clock reset, variable sample timing and two-year-late arrivals do not fabricate source order.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Acquired versus derived
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve lineage and distinguish native receipt from transformations, reports, simulations, predictions and model outputs where their origin is known.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Each derived result pins parent/procedure/version; unknown generation method is explicit, not guessed.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Composition and selectors
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve supplied nested composition and address supported parts with revision-specific selectors.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Native container survives; selectors address correct parts/revisions and malformed recursive expansion is bounded.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Unknown and unsupported states
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall capture admitted opaque content while exposing missing, partial, reference-only, unsupported and failed-processing states.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Unknown optional extensions round-trip; unknown required interpretation is unsupported; empty bytes differ from no payload.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Durable commit acknowledgement
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall acknowledge a requested supported durable level only after required payloads and commit metadata meet that level.
observation_requirements.acceptance: No acknowledged record loses required payload/metadata under the selected declared fault model.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Idempotent retry
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall resolve retries using scoped occurrence/idempotency identity while preserving distinct byte-identical occurrences.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Delivery repeats do not create duplicate occurrences; independent identical inputs retain separate origins.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Crash recovery
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall recover staged work, committed records, outbox effects and consumer cursors without silent loss or repetition of committed effects.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Kill-point recovery reconstructs accepted records and resumes each cursor; unknown outcomes remain queryable.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Bounded processing
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall bound queues, recursive parsing, query work and optional worker resources independently of raw intake.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Worker/parser overload stays within configured bounds and cannot stall admitted intake within its own declared budget.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Admission and coverage
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall apply declared admission/backpressure/sampling policy and expose known or unknown acquisition gaps and losses.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Offered/admitted/rejected/dropped/unknown counts reconcile and no silent sampling occurs.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Latency and throughput
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall meet a prospectively pinned capacity and latency profile including queueing, durability and stated concurrent reads/workers.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Profile P0 or P1 workload meets specified latency/throughput/memory criteria; no target is reported as achieved without evidence.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: No required model tokens
observation_requirements.statement: The mandatory intake, commit, registered-identity lookup and replay path shall require zero model inference calls and model tokens.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Instrumentation and dependency-failure checks observe zero model calls on that path; optional workers counted separately.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Bounded evidence access
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall provide paginated source/time/region/part access with native precision, commit cursors and projection freshness.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Bounded queries retrieve exact requested retained evidence or explicit unavailable/limit status without full-history serialization.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Availability and fault profiles
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall distinguish local recovery from replicated HA and expose acknowledgement/failover semantics for each supported profile.
observation_requirements.acceptance: P1 meets specified SLI/failover/RPO under pinned metadata-and-payload topology; minority/no-authority writes cannot diverge.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Capacity expansion
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall support qualified expansion without changing evidence/identity semantics or requiring global per-observation identity scans.
observation_requirements.acceptance: N-to-2N experiment and hot-source/read-mix cases meet the declared expansion criterion or record the bottleneck.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Retention and restoration
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall retain or explicitly retire payloads and their required schemas, configuration, calibration and identity dependencies under separate policies.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Restore reconstructs permitted retained evidence/identity; eviction or lost keys/decoders produces explicit unavailable status.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Schema longevity
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall version schemas/profiles/descriptors, preserve unknown optional metadata and prohibit silent reinterpretation of historical fields.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Old/new readers round-trip supported extensions and reject unsupported critical interpretation while retaining native data.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Identity uncertainty and conflict
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall keep reported, candidate and operationally accepted bindings distinct and prevent disputed equivalence propagation.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Adversarial fixture has no forced false merge; conflicts invalidate shortcuts; learned natural-data accuracy remains separately unqualified.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Acquisition requests
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall execute supported acquisition-setting requests within declared capabilities and record requested/actual/denied/failed outcomes.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Repeated request IDs are accounted and commands, acknowledgements and measured outcomes remain distinct.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Scope and parser isolation
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall enforce declared scope access and resource isolation for intake, query and optional decoders.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Cross-scope references are not joined without explicit authority and hostile nested input cannot exhaust the core.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Operational accounting
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall expose complete outcome, coverage, lag, resource and cost accounting for eligible offered and admitted work.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Client and server accounting reconcile, outages cannot disappear from denominators, and worker cost is not omitted.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Versioned policies
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall pin admission, retention, binding and processing policy versions needed to reconstruct a declared historical view.
observation_requirements.acceptance: Replaying the same committed prefix and policy gives the same bookkeeping view or declares a nondeterministic procedure/version.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

observation_requirements.title: Derived-view compatibility
observation_requirements.statement: The layer shall version decoder/model/descriptor outputs and preserve their input selectors and compatibility limits.
observation_requirements.acceptance: A worker version change creates a new view and cannot silently mix incompatible descriptors.
observation_requirements.rationale: Derived to fulfill the named upstream requirements; detailed choice challenges and alternatives are in REVIEW.md.

specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Admission, fairness and budgets

specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Source registration and descriptor cache
specifications.statement: Use versioned scoped origins and cached registered identity; no model lookup is required.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Supported acquisition controls
specifications.statement: Record capability, request identity, requested/actual settings and outcomes.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Isolation and receipt accounting
specifications.statement: Preserve scope, source fairness, and complete offered/admitted outcome accounting.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Commit and outbox authority
specifications.statement: Native payload barrier precedes the atomic manifest/log/outbox commit.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Occurrence and retry semantics
specifications.statement: Idempotency is scoped to occurrence/epoch; policy versions and distinct identical occurrences remain recoverable.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Chunks, composition and retention
specifications.statement: Chunked native objects preserve composition, dependencies, explicit availability and coverage events.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Recovery and reconciliation
specifications.statement: Reconcile staged orphans and cursor effects without deleting potentially live blobs.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Replicated durability and fencing
specifications.statement: Declare and qualify metadata plus payload durability, authority and failover eligibility.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Capacity, inference independence and metrics
specifications.statement: Measure bounded commit performance/expansion and account for work without mandatory model inference.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Dated registry and reversible assertions
specifications.statement: Separate producer/subject/position/artifact roles with valid/recorded times and policy versions.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Candidate and conflict handling
specifications.statement: Do not auto-merge candidates or propagate a disputed bridge.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Cursor, selector and watermark reads
specifications.statement: Return bounded exact/history reads and explicit unknown, unavailable or projection-lag states.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Schema and dependency retention
specifications.statement: Archive required descriptors and preserve schema meaning across migrations.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Query and index budgets
specifications.statement: Bound reads/search/rebuild, avoid full scans on receipt, expose measured lag and no required model calls.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Scoped registry and query authority
specifications.statement: Cross-scope associations/reads require explicit permitted authority.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Bounded lazy parsing
specifications.statement: Retain native material and cap nesting, members, expanded bytes, time and memory.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Derived lineage
specifications.statement: Every result pins acquired inputs/selectors, procedure/version and declared loss.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Association proposals
specifications.statement: Emit evidence-backed candidates/alternatives; no qualified natural-data auto-accept policy is supplied.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Versioned descriptors
specifications.statement: New models/decoders create new compatible-or-explicitly-incompatible views.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Lag and scope isolation
specifications.statement: Worker overload remains separate from raw-commit resources and scope access.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

specifications.title: Worker cost visibility
specifications.statement: Enabled job resources and inference are budgeted and exposed, never hidden as zero-cost intake.
specifications.rationale: Implements the allocated requirement acceptance without adding an independent semantic commitment.

decisions.title: Four modules, not nine deployed services
decisions.rationale: Choose the simplest complete implementation; isolate workers and split services only after a measured bottleneck.

decisions.title: Native evidence plus optional views
decisions.rationale: Preserve received distinctions and future reanalysis; reject text-only or embedding-only authority.

decisions.title: Eight-field core with shared origins
decisions.rationale: Reduce repeated acquisition metadata; retain original meanings in descriptors and sparse profiles; benchmark physical encoding.

decisions.title: Operational identity with abstention
decisions.rationale: Persist supported continuity and allow reversibility; no missing evidence can be manufactured by a registry.

decisions.title: No required intake inference
decisions.rationale: Avoid unbounded model latency/token cost before evidence is committed; optional recognition is separately budgeted.

decisions.title: One commit authority
decisions.rationale: Keep spool, payload staging, metadata/outbox and checkpoints unambiguous with explicit backend barriers.

decisions.title: Separate local and HA profiles
decisions.rationale: Local recovery is not HA; durability and availability tradeoffs require a qualified replicated topology.

decisions.title: Capacity vectors and bounded access
decisions.rationale: Expansion is measured under declared byte/rate/query/retention limits; no infinite-scale promise.

decisions.title: One trace source and reusable method
decisions.rationale: Avoid duplicated drifting requirements; generated views and structural checks support later layer flowdown.

assumptions.statement: Available sensors/interfaces provide finite, fallible digital observations; storing bytes is not understanding.
Hardware, backend durability, capacity and retention budgets will be pinned before implementation qualification.
Quantitative P0/P1 targets are engineering proposals; no throughput, HA or token-advantage result exists yet.
Cross-modal natural-data identity recognition has no qualified automatic acceptance algorithm in this increment.
